## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem you're trying to solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## How this fits FlowOS

Explain how this feature aligns with FlowOS's [north star](docs/01-north-star-and-non-goals.md) and current roadmap.

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
